FORM NUMBER: DP-0703
EDITION: 02-24
POLICY LINE: dwelling-fire
EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-02-01
TITLE: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Dwelling Property 3 - Special Form, issued for tenant-occupied rental dwellings.
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 1. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this endorsement:
(a) "Tenant-occupied period" means any period during which the dwelling is leased to one or more tenants under a written or oral rental agreement.
(b) "Burst supply line" means the sudden rupture of any pipe, hose, or fitting carrying potable water under pressure within the described dwelling.
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 2. SCOPE OF THIS ENDORSEMENT
This endorsement scopes exclusion codes E-61 and E-62 as applied to Coverage A - Dwelling for tenant-occupied rental dwellings on the dwelling-fire policy line.
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 3. EXCLUSIONS TABLE
The following exclusions apply to Coverage A - Dwelling:
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
| Code | Exclusion Description | Applies To | Exception |
| E-61 | Water damage from a burst supply line occurring while the dwelling is unoccupied between tenancies for more than 30 consecutive days | Coverage A - Dwelling | Does NOT apply if the water supply was shut off at the main and the plumbing system drained during the unoccupied period. |
| E-62 | Water damage of any kind where the landlord failed to maintain heat of at least 55 degrees Fahrenheit during the months of November through March | Coverage A - Dwelling | None. Freeze-related losses without maintained heat are excluded absolutely. |
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 4. LANDLORD DUTIES
The named insured must inspect the dwelling within 7 days of a tenancy ending and document the condition of visible plumbing. Failure to inspect voids the exception in exclusion E-61.
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 5. OTHER TERMS
All other provisions of the policy remain unchanged.
title: Rental Dwelling Water Damage Limitation Endorsement

FORM NUMBER: HO-0304
EDITION: 03-24
POLICY LINE: homeowners
EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-03-01
TITLE: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Homeowners 3 - Special Form.
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 1. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this endorsement:
(a) "Sudden and accidental" means an abrupt event that is unforeseen, unintended, and occurs over a period of 14 days or fewer from first discharge to discovery.
(b) "Supply line" means any pipe, hose, or fitting that carries potable water under pressure to a plumbing fixture or appliance within the residence premises.
(c) "Surface water" means water on the surface of the ground, irrespective of its source, including flood, waves, and overflow of any body of water.
(d) "Continuous seepage" means discharge or leakage of water that occurs over a period exceeding 14 days, whether or not detectable by the insured.
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 2. SCOPE OF THIS ENDORSEMENT
This endorsement scopes exclusion codes E-15 through E-18 as applied to Section I - Property Coverages. Where a conflict exists between this endorsement and the base wording HO-3 ed. 10-22, this endorsement controls for losses occurring on or after the effective date shown above.
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 3. EXCLUSIONS TABLE
The following exclusions apply to Section I - Property Coverages:
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
| Code | Exclusion Description | Applies To | Exception |
| E-15 | Flood, surface water, waves, tidal water, or overflow of any body of water | All Section I coverages | None. Flood must be insured separately. |
| E-16 | Water which backs up through sewers or drains, or which overflows from a sump | Coverage A and Coverage C | Covered only if endorsement HO-0820 is attached to the policy. |
| E-17 | Water damage from a burst or ruptured supply line | Coverage A - Dwelling | Does NOT apply where the discharge was sudden and accidental as defined in Clause 1(a); such losses remain covered up to policy limits. |
| E-18 | Continuous seepage or leakage from plumbing over a period exceeding 14 days | All Section I coverages | None. Losses from continuous seepage are excluded absolutely. |
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 4. DUTIES AFTER A WATER LOSS
The insured must take reasonable steps to stop the discharge, protect the property from further damage, and retain the failed pipe, fitting, or appliance component for inspection. Failure to retain the failed component may void coverage otherwise preserved by the E-17 exception.
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 5. OTHER TERMS
All other provisions of the policy remain unchanged.
title: Water Damage Exclusions Endorsement

FORM NUMBER: HO-0415
EDITION: 01-24
POLICY LINE: homeowners
EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-01-15
TITLE: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Homeowners 3 - Special Form.
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 1. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this endorsement:
(a) "Cosmetic damage" means marring, pitting, denting, or other superficial alteration of the roof surfacing that does not prevent the roof from continuing to function as a barrier to entrance of the elements.
(b) "Roof surfacing" means the shingles, tiles, membrane, or metal panels exposed to the weather, including underlayment and flashing.
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 2. SCOPE OF THIS ENDORSEMENT
This endorsement scopes exclusion codes E-21 and E-22 as applied to Coverage A - Dwelling. It applies only to loss caused by wind or hail occurring on or after the effective date shown above.
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 3. EXCLUSIONS TABLE
The following exclusions apply to Coverage A - Dwelling:
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
| Code | Exclusion Description | Applies To | Exception |
| E-21 | Cosmetic damage to roof surfacing caused by hail | Coverage A - Dwelling | Does NOT apply if the hail impact penetrates the underlayment or causes water intrusion within 30 days of the storm event. |
| E-22 | Damage to metal roof surfacing consisting solely of denting, without loss of water-shedding function | Coverage A - Dwelling | None. Denting of metal roofs is excluded absolutely. |
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 4. ROOF INSPECTION RIGHT
The insurer may inspect the roof surfacing within 60 days of a reported wind or hail claim. The insured shall not authorize permanent repairs before inspection except emergency measures to prevent further damage.
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 5. OTHER TERMS
All other provisions of the policy remain unchanged.
title: Roof Surfacing Cosmetic Damage Exclusion Endorsement

FORM NUMBER: HO-0509
EDITION: 06-24
POLICY LINE: homeowners
EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-06-01
TITLE: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Homeowners 3 - Special Form.
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 1. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this endorsement:
(a) "Home business" means a trade, profession, or occupation conducted on the residence premises that produced gross receipts exceeding 5,000 dollars in the 12 months before the loss.
(b) "Business property" means property used primarily for a home business, including inventory, samples, and tools of the trade.
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 2. LIMITS OF LIABILITY
Coverage C - Personal Property is limited to 2,500 dollars for business property on the residence premises, and 500 dollars for business property away from the residence premises. These are sublimits, not additional amounts of insurance.
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 3. EXCLUSIONS TABLE
The following exclusions apply to Section II - Liability Coverages:
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
| Code | Exclusion Description | Applies To | Exception |
| E-31 | Bodily injury or property damage arising out of a home business | Coverage E and Coverage F | Does NOT apply to a home day care serving 3 or fewer children where no fee beyond expense reimbursement is charged. |
| E-32 | Professional services rendered or which should have been rendered | Coverage E and Coverage F | None. Professional liability must be insured separately. |
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 4. NOTICE OBLIGATION
The insured must notify the insurer within 30 days of commencing a home business that meets the definition in Clause 1(a). Failure to notify suspends the exception in exclusion E-31.
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 5. OTHER TERMS
All other provisions of the policy remain unchanged.
title: Home Business Property and Liability Limitation Endorsement

FORM NUMBER: HO-0612
EDITION: 03-24
POLICY LINE: homeowners
EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-03-01
TITLE: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Homeowners 3 - Special Form.
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 1. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this endorsement:
(a) "Ordinance or law" means any ordinance or law regulating the construction, demolition, remodeling, renovation, or repair of buildings, in force at the time of loss.
(b) "Undamaged portion" means the part of a covered building structure that did not sustain direct physical loss but must be demolished or altered to comply with an ordinance or law.
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 2. INCREASED LIMIT
The Ordinance or Law coverage percentage stated in the base wording is increased from 10 percent to 25 percent of the Coverage A limit of liability shown in the Declarations. This increase applies only to losses occurring on or after the effective date shown above.
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 3. COVERED COSTS
The insurer will pay the increased costs the insured actually incurs to: (a) demolish and clear the site of the undamaged portion when required by ordinance or law; (b) rebuild or repair to the minimum standard the ordinance or law requires.
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 4. EXCLUSIONS TABLE
The following exclusions apply to this endorsement:
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
| Code | Exclusion Description | Applies To | Exception |
| E-41 | Costs to comply with any ordinance or law requiring remediation of pollutants, including testing and monitoring | This endorsement | None. Pollutant remediation is excluded absolutely. |
| E-42 | Loss in value of the building due to the requirements of any ordinance or law | This endorsement | None. Diminution in value is not a covered cost. |
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 5. OTHER TERMS
All other provisions of the policy remain unchanged.
title: Ordinance or Law Increased Coverage Endorsement

FORM NUMBER: HO-0820
EDITION: 05-24
POLICY LINE: homeowners
EFFECTIVE DATE: 2024-05-01
TITLE: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
THIS ENDORSEMENT CHANGES THE POLICY. PLEASE READ IT CAREFULLY.
This endorsement modifies insurance provided under the Homeowners 3 - Special Form.
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 1. DEFINITIONS
For the purposes of this endorsement:
(a) "Water backup" means water or waterborne material which backs up through sewers or drains, or which overflows or is discharged from a sump, sump pump, or related equipment.
(b) "Related equipment" means the sump pit, discharge piping, check valves, and battery backup unit serving the sump pump.
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 2. COVERAGE GRANT
The insurer will pay up to 10,000 dollars per loss event for direct physical loss to property covered under Section I caused by water backup. This coverage overrides exclusion E-16 of endorsement HO-0304 while this endorsement remains attached to the policy. A deductible of 1,000 dollars applies separately to this coverage.
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 3. EXCLUSIONS TABLE
The following exclusions apply to this endorsement:
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
| Code | Exclusion Description | Applies To | Exception |
| E-51 | Water backup caused by the insured's failure to keep the sump pump in working order | This endorsement | Does NOT apply if the failure was caused by a power outage lasting more than 12 continuous hours. |
| E-52 | Water backup occurring while the residence premises is vacant for more than 60 consecutive days | This endorsement | None. Vacancy beyond 60 days suspends this coverage. |
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 4. MAINTENANCE DUTY
The insured must test the sump pump and related equipment at least once every 90 days and retain proof of battery backup replacement performed within the 24 months preceding a claimed loss.
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement

text:
CLAUSE 5. OTHER TERMS
All other provisions of the policy remain unchanged.
title: Water Backup and Sump Discharge Coverage Endorsement
